verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API and an MCP server, but nothing mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. A raw REST API and an MCP endpoint are different capabilities from an SDK. The advertised OpenAPI spec link is dead, so there is not even a contract from which a client could be generated. The axis applies to an API-bearing SaaS product, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
